articles.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

articles.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
articles.snippet: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
